vo.en: You are being watched right now.

visual.description: A close-up of a man's eyes illuminated by a glowing smartphone screen in a dark room.

vo.en: Check the top corner of your phone. Is there a tiny green or orange dot?

visual.description: Extreme macro shot of the top status bar of a smartphone showing a tiny colored privacy indicator.

vo.en: That isn't a design feature. It means an app is actively using your camera or microphone.

visual.description: A digital audio waveform moving across the screen with a glitch effect.

vo.en: But here is the creepy part. This only catches the amateur apps.

visual.description: A silhouette of a hooded man typing rapidly on a keyboard in a dark office.

vo.en: Pull down your control center and look for the screen mirroring icon right now.

visual.description: A man's hand swiping down on a smartphone screen to reveal the control panel settings.

vo.en: If that icon is blue or shows a strange device name, your screen is being broadcasted.

visual.description: A security camera lens rotating slowly, reflecting a digital screen.

vo.en: Kill your Wi-Fi and check your permissions immediately. Subscribe to stay protected and comment CLEAN if you're safe. Your digital ghost is lurking, which is exactly why

visual.description: A hand pressing a large 'power off' button on a screen followed by a digital shield icon appearing.
